ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme low-intensity dominance with high-intensity pixels constituting less than 3% of the visible fluke surface, primarily localized to the tips and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform low-intensity dark gray to black distribution across both lobes; isolated high-contrast pixel clusters are mapped to the distal lobe tips and the immediate periphery of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated obtuse angle of 115 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 units; primary jaggedness clustered at the extreme lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping from the median notch toward the distal terminal points of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast white pixel clusters at both the far-left and far-right distal tips, with smaller clusters scattered near the trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, positioned approximately mid-way between the median notch and the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'tattered' appearance of the distal tips where pixel density shows significant irregular voids along the trailing edge boundary.
